Name: Jinsè Kegawa
Information:
**Jinsè Kegawa**

**Title** The Herding Heatwave
**Gemstone** Autumn Emerald
**Type** Oucumenael
**Originator** Luxus

Jinsè Kegawa is a protector of helpless animals who has wool made of crimson emerald fibers. They wander, grazing and feeding, known to fly into a fiery frenzy when attacked or bothered by anything that is not a docile animal. When called upon by Suzaku no Sorani, it is an attack dog that hunts down other creatures to burn them to the ground. Its fleece provides extreme offensive and defensive abilities.

Stat Blocks.title: Jinsè Kegawa
Stat Blocks.ability_note: *the checks, saves, and skills listed includes their +1 Cosmogony Bonus

traits.name: Charging Ram
traits.description: If Jinsè Kegawa moves at least 20 feet on their turn before making an attack, that next attack has advantage, and if it hits, its target is knocked prone if they are Medium or smaller.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Jinsè Kegawa makes two attacks with its Emerald Horns.

actions.name: Emerald Horns
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Cosmic Shard: Firefleece Cloud (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: The fleece on Jinsè Kegawa heats up and becomes red hot. Until the start of its next turn, each time a creature hits it with an attack from within 20 feet, they take 7 (2d6) fire damage. Then, at the start of Jinsè Kegawa’s next turn, the heat explodes outward, forcing each creature within 30 feet to make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) fire damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success. A creature who fails by 10 points or more is ignited, and takes 7 (2d6) fire damage from the condition.

options.name: Hot Roll
options.description: Jinsè Kegawa rolls in a fiery ball, moving up to its movement speed. Each creature who comes within 10 feet of it during this movement takes a 5 (d8) of fire damage.

options.name: Superheat
options.description: The next weapon attack made against Jinsè Kegawa has disadvantage, and if it hits the weapon superheats in the hands of its wielder, who must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they drop that weapon due to its heat, and if they pick it up again before the end of Jinsè Kegawa’s next turn, they take 9 (2d8) fire damage.

options.name: Exhausting Heatwave (Costs 2 Actions)
options.description: Jinsè Kegawa unleashes a wave of heat, which halves the movement speed of each creature within 30 feet of them who are not resistant or immune to fire damage until the start of Jinsè Kegawas next turn.
